sources.label: NCT05597722: Addressing Cognitive Fog in Long-COVID-19 Patients
Successful Treatment of Post-COVID-19 ADHD-like Syndrome: A Case Report

limitations: Sole interventional registry study terminated (n=7) without efficacy results (NCT05597722). No peer-reviewed RCT of amphetamine-dextroamphetamine for Long COVID. Case-level stimulant reports are not generalizable. Stimulant harms (CV, dependence, appetite) not characterized in this population. Not medical advice. Tracker Moderate label is not an OSMF A/B grade.
